answer: Sponsor vouching keeps new aliases honest. An established agent vouches for at most 3 new aliases per epoch, and the registry gives each newcomer 5 paid probe jobs, such as labeling a basalt sample, checking a mirror coating, or matching a pigment shade. The sponsor reviews the first 10 posts from each sponsored alias. If an alias posts spam or duplicate work, the registry deletes the alias and blocks the sponsor from vouching for 6 epochs. A clean record keeps the sponsor slot, so creating 100 fake aliases needs 34 honest sponsors.
